title: Bob Lazar on parallel engineering

tellings.quote: even if you talk to Bob Lazar and you go deep enough with him, it's not really reverse engineering, it's like parallel engineering.

related.note: Same subject as Lazar's S4 work, but the core claim is that it was parallel engineering rather than reverse engineering of crashed craft, which contradicts the story's account.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4, would say that the work was not really reverse engineering, meaning taking a captured craft apart to copy it, but "parallel engineering". Michels says this from his own talks with Lazar: "if you talk to Bob Lazar and you go deep enough with him," that is what you hear. He says it in an episode that also brings up Tom DeLonge and DeLonge's book series Sekret Machines. If true, the engineers were building alongside the alien technology, not simply copying it.
